title: Goldman Sachs Bets Again on Options ETFs With NEOS Deal
title_zh: 高盛通过 NEOS 交易再次押注期权 ETF
summary: The bank will pay up to $2.25 billion for NEOS.
summary_zh: 该银行将为 NEOS 支付高达 22.5 亿美元的费用。

title: The Latest Inflation Update Offers Incredible News for Social Security's 2027 COLA
title_zh: 最新的通胀更新为社会保障 2027 年可乐提供了令人难以置信的消息
summary: The first of three puzzle pieces used to calculate Social Security's annual raise was just announced.
summary_zh: 用于计算社会保障年度加薪的三块拼图中的第一块刚刚公布。

title: Apple Reportedly Negotiates Deals With Publishers For Real-Time Content To Power AI-Powered Siri
title_zh: 据报道，苹果正在与出版商就实时内容进行谈判，以支持人工智能 Siri
summary: Apple is negotiating multiyear licensing deals with media companies to supply current news content to its upgraded Siri voice assistant using a pay-per-use compensation model.
summary_zh: 苹果正在与媒体公司就多年许可协议进行谈判，以使用按使用付费的补偿模式向升级后的 Siri 语音助手提供当前新闻内容。

title: Goldman Sachs' $2.25B NEOS Deal Hands It Ready-Made Bitcoin Income ETF Business
title_zh: 高盛 2.25 亿美元 NEOS 交易为其现成的比特币收入 ETF 业务提供支持
summary: The cash-and-equity deal for the options-income specialist folds in NEOS's roughly $1 billion Bitcoin covered-call fund, giving Goldman instant scale in a crypto ETF niche it had only just entered on paper.
summary_zh: 这家期权收入专家的现金加股权交易纳入 NEOS 约 10 亿美元的比特币备兑看涨期权基金，使高盛在刚刚进入纸面的加密 ETF 利基市场中立即扩大规模。

title: Goldman Sachs to Acquire NEOS Investments in Deal Worth Up to $2.25B, Expanding Options-Based ETF Lineup
title_zh: 高盛将以高达 $2.25B 的交易收购 NEOS 投资，扩大基于期权的 ETF 产品阵容
summary: Goldman Sachs will acquire NEOS Investments in a deal worth up to $2.25 billion, adding $30 billion in options-based income ETFs and vaulting Goldman Sachs Asset Management into the ranks of top-eight active ETF issuers.
summary_zh: 高盛将以高达 22.5 亿美元的交易收购 NEOS Investments，增加 300 亿美元的基于期权的收益 ETF，并使高盛资产管理跻身前八名活跃 ETF 发行人之列。
